name: io.github.iancollins27/mailsnail-no-account
title: MailSnail (no account)
description: USPS letters and certified mail from any AI agent. No account, no sign-in: free proof, pay by link.

tools.name: verify_address
tools.description: Check a US mailing address against USPS records. Returns `deliverability`: `deliverable` when USPS recognizes the address, or `undeliverable` with a `reason` when it does not. Free: does not charge or mail anything.

tools.name: preview_letter
tools.description: Create a proof of a letter without charging or mailing it. No account is needed. Returns `proof_url` (a PDF of exactly what will be printed), the USPS address check on the recipient as `to_deliverability`, the exact price as `price_cents` (paid by card, for this one letter), and a `draft_id`. Calling send_letter with that draft_id returns the page where the user pays for exactly this proof at exactly that price, so reviewing the proof and price with the user first avoids mistakes on a paid, irreversible send. The letter is typed text (`body_text`); US addresses only. Priced at our cost and paid by card, one letter at a time: from $1.51 for a first-class letter, $8.83 certified, $11.83 certified with an electronic return receipt, and $14.42 certified with a green-card return receipt; extra pages and color are priced at our cost.

name.description: Full name of recipient or sender
Full name of recipient or sender

body_text.description: Plain text of the letter, rendered to a letter-sized PDF server-side.

extra_service.description: `certified`: USPS Certified Mail (tracking + proof of mailing). `certified_return_receipt`: adds the physical green card (PS Form 3811) signed on delivery and mailed back to the `from` address. `certified_return_receipt_electronic`: adds a PDF of the delivery signature instead of the physical card (cheaper).

tools.name: send_letter
tools.description: Start mailing the letter that preview_letter proofed. Takes the `draft_id` and returns `pay_url`, a Mailsnail page where the user pays for exactly that letter by card on a Stripe-hosted checkout (no account, and no card is saved). This call charges nothing and mails nothing: the letter is mailed when the user's payment completes, and that is irreversible, so call it only once the user has approved the proof and the price. After the user has paid, get_letter with the same draft_id gives the letter's status and tracking. Priced at our cost and paid by card, one letter at a time: from $1.51 for a first-class letter, $8.83 certified, $11.83 certified with an electronic return receipt, and $14.42 certified with a green-card return receipt; extra pages and color are priced at our cost.

draft_id.description: The draft_id from preview_letter, whole. It names exactly that proof and its price.

tools.name: get_letter
tools.description: Get the status of a letter by the `draft_id` it was previewed and paid under: whether it has been paid for, whether it has been handed to the printer, and its latest USPS scan once it has been mailed. For certified letters the result includes the USPS tracking number and a usps.com tracking link. Free: read-only, does not charge.

draft_id.description: The draft_id from preview_letter that send_letter was called with.
